title: Local Galois cohomology and the ell-adic quotient
statement: Let R be an excellent strictly henselian DVR with algebraically closed residue field of prime characteristic p. Let ell be a prime different from p and A a finite ring annihilated by some power of ell. For every discrete continuous A-module M over the absolute Galois group G of Frac(R), there exists a discrete continuous A-module N for the additive ell-adic integers such that finiteness of M implies finiteness of N and H^q(G,M) is isomorphic to H^q(Z_ell,N) in every natural degree. Here H is [def-exc-continuous-cohomology]; N is constructed as invariants under the kernel of the ell-coordinate of a tame quotient.

proof.text: Strict henselianity supplies henselianity. Apply the tame Galois sequence to the fraction field and its separable closure, and compose the continuous surjection with the ell-coordinate projection. This projection is continuous and surjective.

source.place: second and third paragraphs; DAG steps 1--5

proof.text: Every finite continuous quotient of the coordinate kernel has order coprime to ell by the tame-coordinate lemma.

source.place: second and third paragraphs; DAG steps 1--5

proof.text: Construct N as the kernel-fixed submodule and use exact-kernel-invariants comparison in each degree. If M is finite, N is finite because it is a subtype of M.

theorem nonempty_dvr_galois_cohomology_iso
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsDiscreteValuationRing R]
    (hR : IsExcellent R) [IsStrictlyHenselianLocalRing R]
    [IsAlgClosed (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) p]
    (ell : ℕ) [Fact ell.Prime] (hell : ell ≠ p)
    (A : Type v) [Ring A] [Finite A]
    (hA : ∃ s : ℕ, (ell ^ s : ℕ) • (1 : A) = 0)
    (M : DiscreteContinuousRep.{v, u, max u w} A
      (Gal(SeparableClosure (FractionRing R)/FractionRing R))) :
    ∃ N : DiscreteContinuousRep.{v, 0, max u w} A (Multiplicative ℤ_[ell]),
      (Finite M.obj.V → Finite N.obj.V) ∧
      ∀ q : ℕ, Nonempty
        (((discreteContinuousCohomologyFunctor
          (Gal(SeparableClosure (FractionRing R)/FractionRing R)) A q).obj M) ≅
        ((discreteContinuousCohomologyFunctor
          (Multiplicative ℤ_[ell]) A q).obj N))
